🔵⚪️ v 🔴🔴

Sandbach United v Stafford Town

There will be a minute’s applause before the game in memory of Jimmy Harrop a Sandbach United supporter who sadly passed away recently. His family and friends are attending the game today in his memory.

🔵⚪️ v 🔴🔴

Sandbach United v Stafford Town

The Bach welcome back two ex Bach players as Sam Lynch is in Stafford’s starting 11 and Callum Parker is on the bench for today’s opponents.

Good to see you back at The Bach and wishing you all the best for the season ahead.

🔵⚪️ v 🔴🔴

Sandbach United v Stafford Town

Two changes to the starting 11 as Saul Shotton and Harry Cain start, and one to the 16 as all inclusive…….Jake Pollard returns to the squad
Today’s Team News for the 3pm kick off this afternoon at The Bach as we take on Stafford Town https://t.co/yb1tQg5ljW
As you wait for kick off we are pleased to announce the continued sponsorship of Captain Robbie Hatton. Thank you for your support. https://t.co/MGRNDrQQ4y

Matchday and it’s a big one against Stafford Town, both teams have been in or around the play offs in the last two seasons so will be an intriguing affair this afternoon, get down and support The Bach!

Adults £6, Concessions £5, U16 £2 https://t.co/YGyaiCWMtd

This Saturday we Face a tough test at home against @StaffordTown1st a team that will sure to be challenging for promotion. 
We will need to be at our best for this one. Come down and support the team and make a great atmosphere. https://t.co/vg9HuOIEfL

Finishes here 3 2 to Foley Meir as The Bach will rue the many chances they missed and have paid the price for giving soft free kicks away and not picking up players in the box in the 1st half. A disappointing result and have to pick themselves up for Saturdays game vStafford Town

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United

3 2

Could have should have been 3 3 but the keeper pulls off some heroics and saves the day literally.

Full Time

🔴⚫️ v 🟡🟡

Foley Meir v Sandbach United 

3 2

As Saul Shotton with a fine far post volley into the opposite corner, what a finish, game on!

Into added time
